title: Cosign Design research coverage
scopeNote: The page was a peer-nomination list, not a list of final winners. Fifty cards were visible and checked. Fourteen people received multi-artifact study; the other thirty-six are roster-only. The footer’s aggregate nomination text was not used as a verified category roster count.
selectionNote: The deep sample favors public primary material about product design, interactive systems, AI interfaces, implementation, and quality practices. This is a research-availability and relevance choice, not a ranking of talent.
confidenceNote: Confidence labels describe source retrieval, attribution, and whether a decision is explicitly documented. They do not certify product performance, independently establish causal claims, or imply that demos were tested. Interviews, team-authored work, documentation, and historical code are labeled accordingly.
publicUseNote: Contains original educational summaries and analysis with source links, no private user context or article reproductions. Authors and projects retain rights to linked works. Inclusion implies neither endorsement nor affiliation.
